Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions
1. How do I choose office furniture that promotes good posture?
Look for chairs that support your lower back and allow your feet to rest flat on the floor. Your desk should be at a height that keeps your arms at a 90-degree angle.
2. What’s the difference between modular and traditional office furniture?
Modular furniture is flexible, allowing you to change and rearrange pieces. Traditional furniture tends to be fixed in place.
3. Are there affordable options for setting up a full office with IKEA furniture?
IKEA’s office furniture stores offer budget-friendly furniture that doesn’t sacrifice style or comfort. It’s easy to set up a functional office without spending a fortune.

4. Can I customize office furniture when buying online?
Definitely! You can choose from a variety of sizes, finishes, and features to create a personalized office setup.
5. What is ergonomic office furniture and why is it important?

Ergonomic furniture supports your body’s natural posture and minimizes strain. It’s crucial for preventing discomfort during long work hours.
6. Are standing desks a good investment for productivity?

6. Are standing desks a good investment for productivity?
Standing desks can improve focus and reduce fatigue, making them a smart investment for long hours of work.
7. How do I choose the right color palette for my office furniture?

Pick colors that complement your workspace or company brand. Lighter colors brighten up small rooms, while darker tones add a professional touch.
